meta.title: Lead Qualification
meta.description: Inbound call from a potential customer exploring the platform for their team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Hi, I'm calling about potentially bringing your platform to our company. We're a team of about 40 people.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Great to hear that — I'd love to learn more. What's your primary use case, and do you have a budget range in mind?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: We're thinking around $2k a month. Mainly customer support automation.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's a great fit for what we do. One quick question — are you the one who'd be making the final call on this, or is there someone else involved in the decision?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Mostly me, but our CFO would need to sign off on anything over $1k a month.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Totally makes sense. What does your timeline look like — are you looking to get something in place in the next few weeks, or still in early exploration?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Probably next quarter. We're still evaluating a couple of options.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Got it. I've noted everything down and I'll have someone from our team reach out to set up a proper intro call — they'll be able to walk you and your CFO through the details. Does that sound good?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Perfect. You'll hear from us within one business day. Have a great rest of your day.

memory.text: Decision maker: shared — CFO sign-off required above $1k
Timeline: next quarter · Still evaluating options

reasoning_steps.text: Budget in range for Pro plan

reasoning_steps.resolved_text: Timeline: next quarter — nurture cadence appropriate

verdict.text: Warm lead — route to account executive

curveball.caller_line: Actually, my colleague handles the budget — I'm not sure the $2k figure is right. Could be more.
curveball.agent_response: No problem at all — I've noted that as approximate for now. What's the best way to loop your colleague in so we can get the right numbers in front of them?
